name: itsdangerous
note: holdout3: a third held-out set, written from the source at this commit after the dev, test and holdout2 sets existed. Every question is about a fact none of the thirty questions in eval/questions/itsdangerous.json and eval/questions/holdout2/itsdangerous.json asks about, and none is a rewording of one. expected_files are paths relative to the repo root; a retrieved record counts as relevant if its file is in the list. Not scored, and no result on it has been looked at.

questions.question: Which text encoding is used when a string has to become bytes before it is signed?
What happens if the derivation scheme is set to a name the code does not recognise?
What error comes back when the value handed in has no separator in it at all?
Does the signature cover the time information as well, or is that appended afterwards?
What is raised when the signature verifies but the value carries no time part?
Why does turning a stored number into a date catch OSError and OverflowError?
How do I pass extra options through to the dumps call of the serializer underneath?
Which single class is the ancestor of every error this library defines?
Are accented and non-Latin characters escaped in the compact payload, or kept as they are?
What must an object I supply in place of the built-in json module implement?
